dedupe_keys.name: elementos puntuales asociados a la red de ferrocarriles de la base topografica armonizada a escala 1 5 000 de la comunidad autonoma de cantabria del ano 2010

description: Elementos puntuales asociados a la red de ferrocarriles de la Base Topográfica Armonizada a escala 1:5.000 de la Comunidad Autónoma de Cantabria del año 2010 is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoservicios.cantabria.es. In the Dataset BTA5000201034RedFerropunse they collect the point elements related to rail communication systems, including suspended transport by cable, zipper, etc. These are in this case the kilometric points associated with the railway network. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Specific elements associated with the railway network of the Harmonised Topographic Base at scale 1:5,000 of the Autonom" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
